nodes.label: Input: flatten grid, build suffix products, init prefix
nodes.action:
ctx['grid'] = ctx['arg0']; ctx['mod'] = 12345; ctx['m'] = len(ctx['grid'][0])
ctx['flat'] = [v for row in ctx['grid'] for v in row]
ctx['nm'] = len(ctx['flat'])
ctx['suf'] = [1] * (ctx['nm'] + 1)
i = ctx['nm'] - 1
while i >= 0:
    ctx['suf'][i] = ctx['suf'][i + 1] * ctx['flat'][i] % ctx['mod']
    i -= 1
ctx['pre'] = 1
ctx['i'] = 0

nodes.label: p[i] = prefix * suffix(i+1) % mod; advance prefix
nodes.action: ctx['grid'][ctx['i'] // ctx['m']][ctx['i'] % ctx['m']] = ctx['pre'] * ctx['suf'][ctx['i'] + 1] % ctx['mod']; ctx['pre'] = ctx['pre'] * ctx['flat'][ctx['i']] % ctx['mod']; ctx['i'] += 1
